questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
secure savings growth = ze re to
secure banking digital = mi ni to
savings banking rural = ka ze ni
growth digital rural = mi ka re
secure savings rural = to ze ka
What is the code for “rural”?
questions.explanation: Answer: ka. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: secure = to, savings = ze, growth = re, banking = ni, digital = mi, rural = ka.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 85 km west, turns right and walks 180 km, then turns right and walks 10 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 195. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 75 km along the initial direction and 180 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(75² + 180²) = 195 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 24 km north, turns left and walks 16 km, then turns left and walks 12 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 20. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 12 km along the initial direction and 16 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(12² + 16²) = 20 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 126 km east, turns left and walks 225 km, then turns left and walks 6 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 255. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 120 km along the initial direction and 225 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(120² + 225²) = 255 km.

questions.stem: H is the mother of D. B is the daughter of D. F is the father of D. How is B related to F?
questions.explanation: Answer: Granddaughter. F is a parent of D, and B is D’s daughter. Hence B is F’s grandchild.

questions.stem: F is the brother of D. D is the mother of H. A is the father of F and D. How is F related to H?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. F is the brother of H’s mother D. Therefore F is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: H is the only daughter of C. C is the father of H. G is the son of H. E is the sister of C. How is C related to G?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. C is the father of H, and H is G’s mother. Thus C is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: In a queue of 40 candidates, a candidate is 20th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 18. New front rank = 20+3 = 23. Back rank = 40 − 23 + 1 = 18.

questions.stem: In a queue of 39 candidates, a candidate is 16th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?

questions.stem: Two articles are sold for ₹2300 each. One earns 25% profit and the other incurs 25% loss. Find the combined cost price (₹, to two decimals).
questions.explanation: Answer: 4906.67. Recover each cost separately: 2300×100/125 + 2300×100/75. Equal selling prices do not imply equal costs.

questions.stem: Two inlet pipes can fill a tank in 26 and 39 hours. An outlet empties it in 65 hours. All three open together. Find the time (hours) to fill the empty tank. (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 20.53. Net rate = 1/26 + 1/39 − 1/65 = 19/390 tank/hour. Required time = 20.53 hours.

questions.stem: A boat covers 152 km in still water in 8 hours. If the stream flows at 2 km/h, how far (km) can it travel upstream in 4 hours?
questions.explanation: Answer: 68. Still-water speed = 19 km/h. Upstream speed = 19 − 2. Distance = speed × 4.

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 6:3. A invests for 12 months; B joins later and invests for 4 months. A receives ₹158400 profit. What is the total profit (₹)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 184800. Profit ratio is 72:12. Each ratio unit = ₹2200. Total = 84 × 2200.

questions.stem: A sum of ₹28000 earns ₹12600 simple interest in 3 years. At the same annual rate, what would be the amount (₹) after 2 years with annual compounding?
questions.explanation: Answer: 37030. Rate = interest ×100/(principal ×3) = 15%. Compound amount = 28000 × (1 + 15/100)².

questions.stem: A container holds 80 litres of pure milk. 16 litres are removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated once more, mixing thoroughly each time. How many litres of milk remain? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 51.2. Each replacement retains 4/5 of the milk. Remaining milk = 80 × (4/5)².

questions.stem: The average weight of 23 people is 29 kg. One person joins and the average rises by 1 kg. Find the new person’s weight (kg).
questions.explanation: Answer: 53. New total minus old total = (23+1)×(29+1) − 23×29 = 53.

questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. After 11 years their ages will be in ratio 3:2. What is the present sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Answer: 33. Let B = x, A = 2x. (2x+11)/(x+11) = 3/2 gives x = 11. Present sum = 3x.

questions.stem: A 160 m train moving at 64.8 km/h overtakes a runner moving in the same direction at 14.4 km/h. Find the time (seconds, to two decimals) to pass the runner.
questions.explanation: Answer: 11.43. Relative speed = (64.8 − 14.4) ×5/18 = 14 m/s. Time = 160/14.

questions.stem: The price of a commodity increases by 20%. A household keeps spending fixed at ₹1500. By what percentage must consumption decrease? (Round to two decimals.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 16.67. New quantity / old quantity = 100/120. Reduction percentage = 20/120 ×100.
